text: Figma catches up with the code on two dashboard parts. Metric Card gains Show detail and Detail (the code's `detail` line) and Show target (off draws the code's plain `progress` bar), and its figure is now bold, as the code sets it, through two new styles, Headline 3 Bold and Headline 4 Bold. Ranked Bar Row gains Show bar (the code's `showBar`) and Show detail with Detail (an item's share or standing, such as 61.0% or 32 of 36). The Bar Chart and Ranked Bar List pages now document a value withheld as not yet due, and a two-part breakdown drawn as a split.
